k: design pattern repository unit of work
a: Unit of Work tracks changes and commits them as one transaction.
DTOs transfer data across process boundaries without domain behavior.
Anti-corruption layers translate external models into domain models.
Choreographed sagas let services react to events without a central orchestrator.
Orchestrated sagas use a coordinator to drive steps.
Outbox/inbox patterns make event publishing and consumption reliable.
Read models are optimized views for queries.
Snapshots speed rebuilding state from long event streams.
Strangler fig incrementally replaces a legacy system.
BFF APIs tailor responses to specific client types.
